en.s: The Peasants' Revolt, also called Wat Tyler's Rebellion or the Great Rising, was a major uprising across large parts of England in 1381. The revolt had various causes, including the socio-economic and political tensions generated by the Black Death in the 1340s, the high taxes resulting from the conflict with France during the Hundred Years' War, and instability within the local leadership of London. The final trigger for the revolt was the intervention of a royal official, John Bampton, in Essex on 30 May 1381. His attempts to collect unpaid poll taxes in Brentwood ended in a violent confrontation, which rapidly spread across the south-east of the country.

zh.s: 农民起义又称瓦特·泰勒起义或大起义，是1381年席卷英格兰大片地区的一场大规模起义。起因包括1340年代黑死病引发的社会经济和政治紧张、百年战争期间高额税收，以及伦敦地方领导层不稳。最终导火索是王室官员约翰·班普顿于1381年5月30日在埃塞克斯干预。班普顿试图征收拖欠的人头税，在布伦特伍德引发暴力冲突，起义迅速蔓延到英格兰东南部。

en.t: The Council of Constance, called by Emperor Sigismund, a supporter of Antipope John XXIII, burns Jerome of Prague following a trial for heresy
en.s: The Council of Constance (Latin: Concilium Constantiense; German: Konzil von Konstanz) was an ecumenical council of the Catholic Church that was held from 1414 to 1418 in the Bishopric of Constance (Konstanz) in present-day Germany. This was the first ecumenical council convened in the Holy Roman Empire. The council ended the Western Schism by deposing or accepting the resignation of the remaining papal claimants and by electing Pope Martin V.

zh.t: 康斯坦茨会议审判异端后将布拉格的耶柔米烧死
zh.s: 康斯坦茨会议（拉丁语：Concilium Constantiense；德语：Konzil von Konstanz）是天主教会于1414年至1418年在今德国康斯坦茨主教区举行的大公会议，也是首次在神圣罗马帝国内召开的大公会议。会议通过废黜或接受仍在位的教宗候选人辞职，并选举马丁五世为教宗，结束了西方教会大分裂。

en.s: The Battle of Lipany (Czech: Bitva u Lipan), also called the Battle of Český Brod, was fought at Lipany 40 km east of Prague on 30 May 1434 and virtually ended the Hussite Wars. An army of moderate Hussite (or Calixtine) nobility and Catholics, called the Bohemian League, defeated the radical Taborites and Orphans (or Sirotci) led by Prokop the Great, the overall commander, and by Jan Čapek of Sány, the cavalry commander.

zh.s: 利帕尼战役也称捷克布罗德战役，发生于1434年5月30日，地点在利帕尼，位于布拉格以东40公里，几乎终结了胡斯战争。温和派胡斯贵族和天主教徒组成的波希米亚联盟，击败了激进派塔博尔派和孤儿派。激进派由普罗科普大帝（总指挥）和扬·查佩克·桑尼（骑兵指挥官）率领。

en.s: The Prince of Anhua rebellion, or the Prince of Anhua's uprising, was a rebellion in China led by Zhu Zhifan, the Prince of Anhua, against the reigning Zhengde Emperor of the Ming dynasty. The rebellion took place in Ningxia, one of the nine military regions along the Mongolian frontier. In 1510, Liu Jin, a court eunuch who held significant power in the government thanks to the trust and support of the Zhengde Emperor, sent officials to Ningxia to enforce tax increases on military households and punish tax debtors, provoking anger and discontent among the local population. Taking advantage of the situation, Zhu Zhifan launched the rebellion on 12 May, declaring it a campaign against Liu Jin. The rebels seized control of the city of Ningxia and eliminated the leading local generals and officials, but the rebellion did not spread beyond the city’s immediate surroundings. In response to the rebellion, pro-government commanders in the region began gathering troops, while the government in Beijing appointed experienced military leaders familiar with local conditions—the general Shen Ying and the official Yang Yiqing—to organize the suppression of the uprising. As reinforcement for the local forces, the government also dispatched more than thirty thousand soldiers from the Beijing garrison against the rebels under the command of the eunuch Zhang Yong. The rebellion ended with little significant fighting on 30 May 1510, after lasting 18 days.

zh.s: 安化王之乱又称安化王起义，是明朝安化王朱寘鐇反抗正德皇帝发动的一场叛乱。叛乱发生在宁夏，那里是蒙古边境九个军事区之一。1510年，深受正德皇帝信任、在朝中势力很大的宦官刘瑾派官员前往宁夏，对军户加税并惩罚欠税者，引发当地民众不满。朱寘鐇于5月12日趁势起兵，声称讨伐刘瑾。叛军夺取宁夏城，杀害当地主要将领和官员，但叛乱没有扩展到城外周边地区。当地支持朝廷的将领开始集结兵力，北京方面则任命熟悉当地情况的资深将领沈英和官员杨一清组织平乱。朝廷还派宦官张永率领三万多名北京驻军增援地方部队。叛乱持续18天，最终于1510年5月30日结束，期间没有发生大规模战斗。

en.s: The Action of 30 May 1563 was the first naval battle of the Northern Seven Years' War (1563–70), taking place on 30 May 1563 near Bornholm. A Danish squadron of 10 ships under Jacob Brockenhuus, at anchor near Bornholm, saw a Swedish squadron of 19 ships, under Jakob Bagge, approaching, and sent only the 3 ships Hercules 81 (flag), Hector 38 and Hjort 46 toward it to show that they didn't want to fight. Unfortunately, when firing 3 shots as a challenge, they managed to hit one of the Swedish ships. The Swedes promptly surrounded and attacked the Danes, capturing all 3 after a 4-hour fight.

zh.s: 1563年5月30日的海战是北方七年战争（1563—1570年）的首场海战，发生在博恩霍尔姆附近。雅各布·布罗肯胡斯率领一支由10艘船组成的丹麦舰队停泊在博恩霍尔姆附近，看到雅各布·巴格率领的19艘瑞典舰队驶来。他只派“赫拉克勒斯”号（81门炮，旗舰）、“赫克托尔”号（38门炮）和“希奥特”号（46门炮）三艘船迎上前去，表示不想交战。不料丹麦船发射三炮示警时，击中了一艘瑞典船。瑞典舰队随即包围并攻击丹麦舰队，经过四小时战斗俘获了这三艘船。

en.s: The Battle of Lillo was a naval battle that took place during the Eighty Years' War. A Dutch fleet under the command of Lodewijk van Boisot defeated a Spanish fleet at anchor between the fortresses of Lillo and Liefkenshoek near Antwerp. The Spanish lost ten ships which were captured by the Dutch.

zh.s: 利洛海战发生于八十年战争期间。洛德韦克·范·布瓦索特指挥的荷兰舰队击败了一支停泊在安特卫普附近利洛和利夫肯斯胡克两座堡垒之间的西班牙舰队。荷兰人俘获了西班牙舰队的十艘船。

en.t: Henry III becomes King of France
en.s: Henry III of France (French: Henri III, né Alexandre Édouard; 19 September 1551 – 2 August 1589) was King of France from 1574 until his assassination in 1589 and, as Henry of Valois (Polish: Henryk Walezy; Lithuanian: Henrikas Valua), King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1573 to 1575. Before he came to these thrones, he was known as the Duke of Angoulême and Duke of Orléans from 1560, then as Duke of Anjou from 1566.

zh.t: 亨利三世成为法国国王
zh.s: 法国国王亨利三世（法语：Henri III，原名亚历山大·爱德华；1551年9月19日—1589年8月2日）于1574年至1589年遇刺前担任法国国王。1573年至1575年，他还以瓦卢瓦的亨利之名担任波兰国王和立陶宛大公。在继承这些王位前，他自1560年起是昂古莱姆公爵和奥尔良公爵，1566年起则为安茹公爵。

en.s: The siege of Zutphen was an eleven-day siege of the city of Zutphen by Dutch and English troops led by Maurice of Nassau, during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. The siege began on 19 May 1591 after a clever ruse by the besiegers. The city was then besieged for eleven days, after which the Spanish garrison surrendered.

en.s: The Wanggongchang Explosion (Chinese: 王恭廠大爆炸), also known as the Great Tianqi Explosion (天啟大爆炸), Wanggongchang Calamity (王恭廠之變) or Beijing Explosive Incident in the late Ming dynasty (晚明北京爆炸事件), was a catastrophic explosion that occurred on May 30, 1626, during the late reign of the Tianqi Emperor at the heavily populated Ming Chinese capital of Beijing, and reportedly killed around 20,000 people.

zh.s: 王恭厂大爆炸又称天启大爆炸、王恭厂之变或晚明北京爆炸事件，是一场灾难性爆炸。爆炸于1626年5月30日在明朝首都北京人口稠密地区发生，当时正值天启皇帝统治后期。据报约有20,000人遇难。

en.t: Publication of Gazette de France, the first French newspaper
en.s: La Gazette (French pronunciation: [la ɡazɛt]), originally Gazette de France, was the first weekly magazine published in France. It was founded by Théophraste Renaudot and published its first edition on 30 May 1631. It progressively became the mouthpiece of one royalist faction, the Legitimists. With the rise of modern news media and specialized and localized newspapers throughout the country in the early 20th century, La Gazette was finally discontinued in 1915.

zh.s: 《法国公报》（La Gazette，法语发音：[la ɡazɛt]）最初名为《法国公报》，是法国第一份周刊。它由泰奥弗拉斯特·勒诺多创办，首期于1631年5月30日发行。该报逐渐成为保王派中的正统派喉舌。20世纪初，现代新闻媒体及各地专业报刊兴起后，《法国公报》于1915年停刊。

en.t: Thirty Years' War: The Peace of Prague is signed
en.s: The Peace of Prague, dated 30 May 1635 Old Style, was a significant turning point in the Thirty Years' War. Signed by John George I, Elector of Saxony, and Ferdinand II, Holy Roman Emperor, the terms ended Saxony's support for the anti-Imperial coalition led by Sweden. Other states within the Holy Roman Empire subsequently joined the treaty, and their exit was a key factor in Catholic France entering the war as an ally of Protestant Sweden.

zh.s: 《布拉格和约》按旧历日期记为1635年5月30日，是三十年战争的重要转折点。萨克森选帝侯约翰·格奥尔格一世与神圣罗马帝国皇帝斐迪南二世签署条约，条款终止了萨克森对瑞典领导的反帝国联盟的支持。神圣罗马帝国内其他邦随后加入条约；它们退出联盟，是天主教法国加入战争、与新教瑞典结盟的关键因素之一。

en.s: The Battle of Cobleskill was an American Revolutionary War raid on the frontier settlement of Cobleskill, New York on May 30, 1778. The battle took place in what is now the hamlet of Warnerville, New York, near the modern Cobleskill-Richmondville High School. The raid marked the beginning of a phase in which Loyalists and Haudenosaunee, encouraged and supplied by British authorities in the Province of Quebec, attacked and destroyed numerous villages on what was then the western frontier of New York and Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 科布尔斯基尔战役是美国独立战争期间发生的一次袭击，目标是纽约州边疆聚居点科布尔斯基尔，日期为1778年5月30日。战斗地点位于如今的沃纳维尔村，靠近科布尔斯基尔—里士满维尔高中。此次袭击标志着新一轮攻势的开始：魁北克省的英国当局向效忠派和豪德诺索尼人提供支持和补给，他们随后袭击并摧毁了当时纽约州和宾夕法尼亚州西部边疆的许多村庄。

en.s: The action of 30 May 1781, also known as the Battle of Cape St Mary (Dutch: Zeegevecht bij Kaap Sint-Marie) was a naval battle fought between two Royal Navy frigates and two Dutch States Navy frigates off the Cabo de Santa Maria. In a battle lasting more than two hours, Captain William Peere Williams-Freeman of the 36-gun Flora, compelled Captain Pieter Melvill van Carnbee's 36-gun Castor to strike his colours.

zh.s: 1781年5月30日海战也称圣玛丽角海战，发生在圣玛丽角附近，是英国皇家海军两艘护卫舰与荷兰共和国海军两艘护卫舰之间的一场海战。战斗持续两个多小时后，36炮护卫舰“弗洛拉”号舰长威廉·皮尔·威廉姆斯-弗里曼迫使36炮荷舰“卡斯托尔”号舰长彼得·梅尔维尔·范·卡恩比降旗投降。

en.s: The 1789 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on May 30, 1789. The former member of the Delaware House of Assembly Joshua Clayton was elected president of Delaware for a term of three years. The previous president Thomas Collins died in office on March 29, 1789. The speaker of the House of Assembly Jehu Davis acted as president pending the election of Collins's successor.

en.s: The Battle of Borghetto, near Valeggio sul Mincio in the Veneto of northern Italy, took place during the War of the First Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. On 30 May 1796, a French army led by General Napoleon Bonaparte forced a crossing of the Mincio River in the face of opposition from an Austrian army commanded by Feldzeugmeister Johann Peter Beaulieu. This action compelled the Austrian army to retreat north up the Adige valley to Trento, leaving the fortress of Mantua to be besieged by the French.

zh.s: 博尔盖托战役发生在意大利北部威尼托大区瓦莱焦苏尔明乔附近，是法国大革命战争期间第一次反法同盟战争的一部分。1796年5月30日，拿破仑·波拿巴将军率领法军在奥地利军队抵抗下强渡明乔河。奥军由约翰·彼得·博利厄指挥。法军此举迫使奥军沿阿迪杰河谷向北撤退至特伦托，并将曼托瓦要塞留给法军围攻。

en.s: The Battle of Newtownmountkennedy was fought on 30 May 1798, between forces of the British Crown and a force of Irish Rebels, during the Irish Rebellion of 1798. The town was base for the Ancient Britons, a British regiment widely reviled in the area for brutality. A rebel force planned an attack from three sides on the town, with each division to be led by Thomas Maguire, James Doyle and Joseph Holt.

zh.s: 1798年爱尔兰起义期间，英国王室军队与爱尔兰叛军于1798年5月30日在纽敦蒙特肯尼迪交战。该镇是英国“古不列颠人”团的驻地，该团因残暴而在当地恶名昭著。叛军计划从三个方向进攻，分别由托马斯·马圭尔、詹姆斯·多伊尔和约瑟夫·霍尔特率领各路部队。

en.s: The Treaty of Paris, signed on 30 May 1814, ended the war between France and the Sixth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars, following an armistice signed on 23 April between Charles, Count of Artois, and the allies. The treaty set the borders for France under the House of Bourbon and restored territories to other nations. It is sometimes called the First Peace of Paris, as another one followed in 1815.

zh.s: 《巴黎条约》于1814年5月30日签署，结束了法国与第六次反法同盟之间的战争，这是拿破仑战争的一部分。此前，阿图瓦伯爵夏尔于4月23日与盟国签署停战协定。条约划定波旁王朝统治下法国的边界，并将领土归还其他国家。由于1815年又签订了一份巴黎条约，这份条约有时称为“第一次巴黎和约”。

The city of Ancona was the last major Italian city to surrender.

en.t: The Kansas–Nebraska Act became law, establishing the U.S. territories of Nebraska and Kansas, and allowing their settlers to determine if slavery would be permitted
en.s: The Kansas–Nebraska Act of 1854 (10 Stat. 277) was a territorial organic act that created the territories of Kansas and Nebraska. It was drafted by Democratic senator Stephen A. Douglas, passed by the 33rd United States Congress, and signed into law by President Franklin Pierce. Douglas introduced the bill with the intention of opening up new lands to develop and facilitate the construction of a transcontinental railroad.

en.s: The siege of Corinth, also known as the first battle of Corinth, was an American Civil War engagement lasting from April 29 to May 30, 1862, in Corinth, Mississippi. A collection of Union forces under the overall command of Major General Henry W. Halleck (in his only field command of the war) engaged in a month-long siege of the city, whose Confederate occupants were commanded by General P.G.T.
en.n: American Civil War: The Siege of Corinth ends in a Union victory, with General Henry Halleck capturing the critical rail junction of Corinth, Mississippi from retreating Confederate forces under General P. G. T. Beauregard.

en.s: The Battle of Old Church, also known as Matadequin Creek, was fought on May 30, 1864, as part of Union Lt. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's Overland Campaign against Confederate Gen. Robert E. Lee's Army of Northern Virginia during the American Civil War. As the opposing armies faced each other across Totopotomoy Creek, a Union cavalry division under Brig. Gen. Alfred T. A. Torbert collided with a cavalry brigade under Brig. Gen. Matthew C. Butler at Matadequin Creek, near the Old Church crossroads. After sharp dismounted fighting, the outnumbered Confederates were driven back to within 1.5 miles (2.4 km) of Old Cold Harbor, which preceded the Union capture of that important crossroads the following day.

zh.s: 老教堂战役也称马塔德昆溪战役，是美国内战期间联邦中将尤利西斯·S·格兰特对阵邦联将军罗伯特·E·李北弗吉尼亚军团的陆上战役的一部分，发生于1864年5月30日。两军隔托托波托莫伊溪对峙时，阿尔弗雷德·T·A·托伯特准将率领的一支联邦骑兵师在老教堂十字路口附近的马塔德昆溪与马修·C·巴特勒准将率领的一支邦联骑兵旅遭遇。双方下马激战后，人数较少的邦联军被击退至距老冷港1.5英里（2.4公里）以内；次日联邦军攻占这一重要路口。

en.t: Bedřich Smetana's comic opera The Bartered Bride (cover of score pictured) premiered in Prague
en.s: The Bartered Bride (Czech: Prodaná nevěsta, The Sold Bride) is a comic opera in three acts by the Czech composer Bedřich Smetana, to a libretto by Karel Sabina. The work is generally regarded as a major contribution towards the development of Czech music. It was composed during the period 1863 to 1866, and first performed at the Provisional Theatre, Prague, on 30 May 1866 in a two-act format with spoken dialogue.

en.s: Memorial Day is a federal holiday in the United States for mourning the U.S. military personnel who died while serving in the U.S. Armed Forces. It is observed on the last Monday of May. Memorial Day is a time for visiting cemeteries and memorials to mourn the military personnel who died in the line of duty. Volunteers will place American flags on the graves of those military personnel in national cemeteries.
en.n: After General Logan's General Order No. 11 to the Grand Army of the Republic to observe May 30, 1868, the earlier version of the holiday began to be referred to as Confederate Memorial Day.

en.s: The Lincoln Memorial is a U.S. national memorial honoring Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States, located on the western end of the National Mall of Washington, D.C. en.s: Buryatia, officially the Republic of Buryatia, is a republic of Russia located in the Russian Far East. To its north lie Irkutsk Oblast and Lake Baikal, the deepest lake in the world; Zabaykalsky Krai to the east; Tuva to the west and Mongolia to the south.

en.s: The 1929 United Kingdom general election was held on 30 May 1929, and resulted in a hung parliament. It was the second of four general elections under the secret ballot and the first of three under universal suffrage in which a party lost the popular vote (i.e. gained fewer popular votes than another party) but gained a plurality of seats (the others being 1874, 1951 and February 1974). In 1929 that party was Ramsay MacDonald's Labour, which won the most seats in the Commons for the first time ever but failed to get an overall majority.

zh.s: 英国于1929年5月30日举行大选，结果产生悬峙议会。这是英国实行秘密投票制后的第四次大选中的第二次，也是普选权实施后首批三次大选中的第一次：有一个政党虽然普选票少于对手，却赢得了最多议席；另外两次分别是1874年、1951年和1974年2月。1929年出现这种结果的是拉姆齐·麦克唐纳领导的工党。工党首次赢得下议院最多席位，但未取得绝对多数。

en.s: The Battle of Heraklion was part of the Battle of Crete, fought during World War II on the Greek island of Crete between 20 and 30 May 1941. British, Australian and Greek forces of 14th Infantry Brigade, commanded by Brigadier Brian Chappel, defended Heraklion port and airfield against a German paratrooper attack by the 1st Parachute Regiment of the 7th Air Division, commanded by Colonel Bruno Bräuer.

en.s: The Irish general election of 1944 was held on 30 May 1944, three weeks after the dissolution of the Dáil on 9 May. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Czechoslovakia on 30 May 1948. en.s: The 1959 People's Action Party (PAP) prime ministerial election was an internal vote conducted by the party's Central Executive Committee (CEC) following the PAP's victory in the 1959 Singaporean general election. The 12-member committee was evenly split between two contenders, Ong Eng Guan and Lee Kuan Yew, each receiving six votes. The deadlock was broken when the party chairman, Toh Chin Chye, cast the tiebreaker in favour of Lee, securing his appointment as Singapore's first Prime Minister.

zh.s: 1959年新加坡大选后，人民行动党中央执行委员会举行内部投票，选出总理人选。委员会12名成员平均分成两派，王永元和李光耀各得六票。党主席杜进才投下打破平局的一票，支持李光耀，使他获任命为新加坡首任总理。

en.s: Rafael Leónidas Trujillo Molina ( troo-HEE-yoh; Spanish: [rafaˈel tɾuˈxiʝo]; 24 October 1891 – 30 May 1961), nicknamed "El Jefe" (Spanish: [el ˈxefe]; lit. zh.s: 拉斐尔·莱昂尼达斯·特鲁希略·莫利纳（1891年10月24日—1961年5月30日），绰号“El Jefe”（西班牙语，意为“老大”），是多米尼加军官和独裁者。他从1930年8月起统治多米尼加，直至1961年5月遇刺身亡。他曾两度担任该国第36任和第39任总统，任期分别为1930至1938年、1942至1952年。

en.s: Mariner 9 (Mariner Mars '71 / Mariner-I) was a robotic spacecraft that contributed greatly to the exploration of Mars and was part of the NASA Mariner program. Mariner 9 was launched toward Mars on May 30, 1971, from LC-36B at Cape Canaveral Air Force Station, Florida, and reached the planet on November 14 of the same year, becoming the first spacecraft to orbit another planet – only narrowly beating the Soviet probes Mars 2 (launched May 19) and Mars 3 (launched May 28), both of which arrived at Mars only weeks later.

en.s: Local government in Northern Ireland was reorganised in 1973 by the Local Government (Boundaries) Act (Northern Ireland) 1971 and the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1972. en.s: The Irish presidential election of 1973 was held on 30 May 1973. Incumbent president Éamon de Valera was 90 years old and constitutionally barred from seeking a third term. His party Fianna Fáil sought to get former Tánaiste Frank Aiken to run for the presidency, but he declined. Under pressure, former Tánaiste Erskine H. Childers agreed to run. en.s: The Convention on Cluster Munitions (CCM) is an international treaty that prohibits all use, transfer, production, and stockpiling of cluster munitions, a type of explosive weapon which scatters submunitions ("bomblets") over an area. Additionally, the convention establishes a framework to support victim assistance, clearance of contaminated sites, risk reduction education, and stockpile destruction. The convention was adopted on 30 May 2008 in Dublin, and was opened for signature on 3 December 2008 in Oslo.

en.t: Former Liberia president Charles Taylor was sentenced to 50 years in prison for his role in atrocities committed during the Sierra Leone Civil War
en.s: Charles McArthur Ghankay Taylor (born 28 January 1948) is a Liberian former politician. en.s: The 2022 CAF Champions League final was the final match of the 2021–22 CAF Champions League, the 58th season of Africa's premier club football tournament organised by CAF, and the 26th edition under the current CAF Champions League title. It was played at the Stade Mohammed V in Casablanca, in Morocco on 30 May 2022. Wydad AC won the match 2–0 to clinch their third Champions League title.

zh.s: 2022年非洲足球冠军联赛决赛决出了2021—22赛季冠军，这是非洲足联主办的顶级俱乐部足球赛事第58个赛季，也是该赛事采用现名后的第26届。比赛于2022年5月30日在摩洛哥卡萨布兰卡穆罕默德五世体育场举行。维达德竞技以2比0获胜，第三次夺得非洲冠军联赛冠军。

en.t: 2022 National Party of Australia leadership spill
en.s: A leadership spill for the federal leadership of the National Party of Australia was held on 30 May 2022. The spill followed the federal election in which the Coalition, of which the Nationals form part, lost government, earlier in the same month. The incumbent leader, Barnaby Joyce, had served as Deputy Prime Minister in the outgoing government. He lost against his deputy David Littleproud, who was elected party leader.

zh.t: 2022年澳大利亚国家党党魁更替投票
zh.s: 澳大利亚国家党联邦党魁选举于2022年5月30日举行。同月早些时候，联邦选举中联盟党失去执政地位，国家党是联盟党的一部分，因此引发此次党魁选举。现任党魁巴纳比·乔伊斯曾在即将卸任的政府中担任副总理。他败给自己的副手戴维·利特尔普劳德，后者当选党魁。

en.s: The 2023 Federation Cup final was the final match of the 2022–23 Federation Cup (Bangladesh), the 34th edition of Bangladeshi premier club football tournament organised by BFF. It was held at Shaheed Dhirendranath Datta Stadium in Cumilla, on 30 May 2023 between Mohammedan SC and Abahani Limited Dhaka. Mohammedan won the match on 4–2 on penalties after full time 4–4 scoreline.

zh.s: 2023年联邦杯决赛是2022—23赛季孟加拉国联邦杯的最后一场比赛，也是孟加拉国足球联合会（BFF）主办的顶级俱乐部足球赛事第34届。比赛于2023年5月30日在库米拉的沙希德·迪伦德拉纳特·达塔体育场举行，由穆罕默丹体育俱乐部对阵达卡阿巴哈尼。双方常规时间战成4比4，穆罕默丹在点球大战中以4比2获胜。

en.t: Donald Trump is convicted of falsifying business records in his New York trial, the first time a former President of the United States has been found guilty in a criminal case
en.s: The president of the United States (POTUS) is the head of state and head of government of the United States. The president directs the executive branch of the federal government and is the commander-in-chief of the United States Armed Forces. The power of the presidency has grown since the first president, George Washington, took office in 1789.

zh.s: 美国总统（POTUS）是美国国家元首和政府首脑，领导联邦政府行政部门，并担任美国武装部队总司令。自首任总统乔治·华盛顿于1789年就职以来，总统职位的权力不断扩大。

en.s: The 2026 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2025–26 UEFA Champions League, the 71st season of Europe's premier club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 34th season since it was renamed from the European Champion Clubs' Cup to the UEFA Champions League. It was played at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest, Hungary, on 30 May 2026 between French club Paris Saint-Germain, the defending champions, and English club Arsenal.

zh.s: 2026年欧洲冠军联赛决赛决出了2025—26赛季欧冠冠军，这是欧足联主办的欧洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事第71个赛季，也是该赛事从欧洲冠军俱乐部杯更名为欧洲冠军联赛后的第34个赛季。比赛于2026年5月30日在匈牙利布达佩斯普斯卡什竞技场举行，由卫冕冠军、法国巴黎圣日耳曼对阵英格兰阿森纳。
